findings.explanation: PO-1005 is referenced by both INV-1005 and REC-1005 but no purchase order document exists anywhere in the transaction evidence set, so the authorization for this spend cannot be verified.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice INV-1005 (2026-07-21) that it references, producing an illogical document sequence.
